issues.justification: 'Не актуально' is a dated Soviet idiom for 'out of fashion/irrelevant'; 'topical' is a stiff, wrong rendering. Also 'Ba-ba-ba' and 'Oh yes, be chill, all right' mistranslate the garbled pseudo-English 'О ес, би чел' (a joke of fake English).

issues.source_quote: Хорошо, что он не контрабандист, симпатичный мужик
issues.translation_quote: I'm glad he's not a smuggler.
issues.justification: Minor loss of nuance, but also 'Ты зачем усы сбрил, дурик?' is fine. The larger issue is the omitted/odd ending lyric and 'Ну-ка иди отсюда, Миша! Как у вас там говорят, топай до хазы' rendered as 'get back to your pad' which loses the mock-criminal slang.

issues.source_quote: Чтоб ты исдох! Чтоб я видел тебя у гробу, у белых тапках! Чтоб ты жил на одну зарплату!
issues.translation_quote: Drop dead! I hope to see you in your coffin, in your little white slippers! May you live... on nothing... but your salary!
issues.justification: The neighbour's Odessa-style dialectal Yiddish-inflected speech ('у гробу, у белых тапках') is rendered in standard English, losing the character voice.

issues.source_quote: Кто возьмёт билетов пачку, тот получит... Водокачку!
issues.translation_quote: Buy a stack of tickets, win a fabulous... waterworks!
issues.justification: The Russian rhyme (пачку/водокачку) is lost and 'fabulous' is an addition; the comic anticlimax is weakened.

issues.source_quote: Шампанское по утрам пьют или аристократы, или дегенераты!
issues.translation_quote: Only aristocrats and degenerates drink champagne in the morning!
issues.justification: Acceptable, but the official Soviet moralizing tone of the building manager could be sharper.
